name: chess-game

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build:desktop: cd client && npx vite build && cd .. && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:win: cd client && npx vite build && cd .. && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: cd client && npx vite build && cd .. && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.sync:mobile: cd client && npx vite build && npx cap sync
scripts.apk: cd client && npx vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug

description: 奶棋 - LAN multiplayer board game
